notes: 3D shooting: one stick length through every shot, follow-through and eyes toward the target, real slapshot wind-up and backhand, high shots finish high, weight transfer, release closer to the body; NHL shot speeds and a real shot map (high-corner goals, glove and blocker saves on the correct side, shots over the net, crossbar hits); deflections fly off the stick; pucks stop where the save is made; rebounds by save type; saves follow game speed. Faceoffs: the best faceoff man takes the draw on the PP and PK.
